scripts.sync:restart: docker compose --env-file docker/.env restart api queue scheduler
scripts.docker:setup: cp -n docker/.env.example docker/.env 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n backend/.env.example backend/.env 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n apps/admin/.env.example apps/admin/.env 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n apps/timesheet/.env.example apps/timesheet/.env 2>/dev/null || true && sh scripts/sync-password-policy.sh
scripts.docker:build: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=1 docker compose --env-file docker/.env build
scripts.docker:up: npm run docker:setup && DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=1 docker compose --env-file docker/.env up -d
scripts.docker:up:build: npm run docker:setup && DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=1 docker compose --env-file docker/.env up -d --build
scripts.docker:test:scripts: sh scripts/docker-sync-deps.test.sh && sh scripts/resolve-sqlite-path.test.sh && sh scripts/docker-reset.test.sh && sh scripts/dev-webhook-tunnel-status.test.sh
scripts.lint: npm run lint:fast && npm run lint:structure
scripts.lint:fast: npm run lint --workspaces --parallel && cd backend && composer lint
scripts.lint:structure: npm run lint:deps & npm run lint:dup & wait
scripts.lint:dup: jscpd --config .jscpd.json apps/admin/src apps/timesheet/src packages/api-client/src packages/password-policy/src packages/ui/src packages/test-utils/src backend/app
scripts.lint:frontend: node_modules/.bin/oxlint apps/admin/src apps/timesheet/src packages/api-client/src packages/password-policy/src packages/ui/src packages/test-utils/src packages/vite-config/src
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:workspaces && cd backend && composer test:coverage
scripts.test:mutation: npm run test:mutation:backend && npm run test:mutation:frontend
scripts.precommit:qa: sh scripts/sync-password-policy.sh && npm run lint:fast && npm run typecheck && cd backend && composer test:arch && composer test:unit && composer test:feature:time-activities && composer test:feature:auth
scripts.prepush: sh scripts/sync-password-policy.sh && npm run qa && npm run lint:dup:tests && npm run test:mutation
scripts.qa: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && sh scripts/qa-tests.sh
scripts.validate:thresholds: npm run test:coverage:workspaces && (cd backend && composer test:coverage && composer test:mutation) && npm run test:mutation:frontend
